acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec names every fold with its old and new invocation, profile IDs kept unchanged, rollback and the shim or structured refusal left at each old name; the owner accepts it before any move.
Each moved command keeps byte-identical output documents under the same profile IDs, proven by golden comparison before and after.
Core keeps exactly the CCF-V1-001 verbs' contracts; each removed non-frozen core verb returns a structured refusal naming its corvint-test replacement, with tests.
The corvint-test* prefix matcher and diagnostic-prefix collisions are resolved with tests.
body: Owner 2026-10-17: "we should make sure we are breaking up the tooling correclty into appropriate binaries" and "maybe it could be called corvint-test as it could cover all types of tests". CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) reserves cmd/corvint-test with only an e2e group (V1-1665) and defers folding. Read-only audit (docs/build-log/2026-10-17-binary-boundary-audit.md): the unshipped experimental companions corvint-test-runner (TRE-V0), corvint-tests-accept (NEA-V0), corvint-behavior-falsify (BBF-V0), corvint-playwright-minimize (PSM-V0) and optionally corvint-web-flows (NEX-V0) are thin cmd wrappers over internal packages and could become corvint-test run|accept|falsify|minimize|flows groups; core verbs that execute user code outside the frozen CCF-V1-001 set (docs/specs/core-compatibility-freeze-v1.md:39) could move their execution half: `corvint test` (internal/sessiontest/run.go:128), `test-validity negate` (cmd/corvint/test_validity_negate.go:190) and the execution half of `prove --mutate` (cmd/corvint/prove.go:1289; prove stays frozen). Keep test-plan and runs in core (read-only projections). Defer the shipped go/js test providers (internal/companionrelease/companionrelease.go:127-128): their names are wire Source values (internal/testvaliditydoc/document.go:230,251; internal/testplan/plan.go:48) and core calls them through `PROVIDER negate --root`. Keep corvint-test-validity-mcp (shipped, MTV-V0). Hazards: internal/companionrelease/retained_test.go:142 maps any corvint-test* name to test-validity-mcp; core `corvint test` already prints `corvint-test:` diagnostics (cmd/corvint/session_test_shards_unix_test.go:82); TRE-V0-021..023 are accepted and need an amendment; main.go edits need a use-case receipt repin.
title: corvint-test: fold the test-executing companions and core test execution into one companion with per-kind groups
